title: Gaze Capsule
meta: Output: 4K/HD digital video (MP4/MOV), seamless loop; USB, download, or NFT
statement:
An eye trapped inside a floating bubble, suspended in constant drift — blinking, expanding, observing, shrinking. The gaze shifts as the bubble travels across surreal skies and translucent dimensions. Nothing stays the same. Even perception mutates.

Gaze Capsule is a surreal meditation on perception, fragility, and the way observation itself shapes emotional space. It plays with scale, refraction, and cyclical motion, offering a layered perspective on consciousness and impermanence.

Soundtrack: Reconnect by Adi Goldstein - licensed via Artlist.io
